name: W Proposes ~Shin'ya no Ikenai Sankaku Kankei~
original_name: Ｗプロポーズ～深夜のイケない三角関係～
source:
You're an editor for a wedding magazine. You have a boyfriend, but it's not the time to think about getting married yet.

One day, unexpectedly, you get a proposal... "I'm never gonna give you up to him. Marry me."

They will seduce you and fight for you! You know it's wrong, but... How far will you go with your new love interest?

Cheating?
Stolen love?
An impactful love game!!

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.ciagram.otome.games.wproposeforeign]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你是一家婚礼杂志的编辑。虽然已经有了男朋友，但还没到考虑结婚的时候。

某天，一场求婚突然降临……“我绝不会把你让给他。嫁给我吧。”

他们将追求你，争夺你的心！你明知这样不对，却还是……你与这位新的恋爱对象，究竟会走到哪一步？

出轨？
夺爱？
一款令人心潮起伏的恋爱游戏！

[来源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.ciagram.otome.games.wproposeforeign]Google Play[/url]]
